RestartTimeoutSeconds.title: Restart polling timeout (seconds)
RestartTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the platform waits for the API to come back online after Restart Platform is clicked. Tune higher for slow cold-starts on Kubernetes or when EF migrations run on startup.

DefaultTheme.title: Default theme
DefaultTheme.description: Initial theme presented to admins who haven’t explicitly chosen one in their browser. Per-user override saved in localStorage always wins.

AllowDestructiveOperations.title: Allow destructive operations
AllowDestructiveOperations.description: When disabled, the Reset Cache and Restart Platform cards are hidden from the System Operations page. Use to lock down production environments while keeping diagnostics accessible.
